question: As per Census 2011, which state of India has the highest sex ratio?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• As per Census 2011, Kerala has the highest sex ratio in India with **1084 females per 1000 males.**
 
• The high sex ratio in Kerala is attributed to **higher literacy rates and better healthcare facilities** compared to other states.
 
• Kerala has consistently maintained a higher sex ratio over the decades, reflecting **gender equality and women empowerment.**
 
• The state has **effective social policies** and programs that support the well-being of women and girls.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sex Ratio:**

 
 
• Sex ratio is the number of females per 1000 males in a given population.
 
• It is an important indicator of gender balance in a society.
 
• Higher sex ratios indicate **better status and well-being of women** in that region.
 
 
 
• **Census 2011:**
 
 
• The 2011 Census is the most recent comprehensive population survey conducted in India.
 
• It provides detailed demographic data, including age, sex, literacy, and occupation.
 
 
 
• **Factors Influencing Sex Ratio:**
 
 
• Socio-economic factors such as literacy, healthcare, and employment opportunities.
 
• Cultural practices and gender preferences can also impact the sex ratio.
 
• Government policies and social reforms aimed at **improving women's status** contribute to a better sex ratio.
 
 
 
• **Gender Equality in Kerala:**
 
 
• Kerala's high sex ratio reflects **progress in gender equality** through education and healthcare.
 
• The state has a high literacy rate, with female literacy at approximately 92%.
 
• Kerala's healthcare system is one of the most advanced in India, providing better maternal and child health services.
